QUOTE: If the project has not defined those, the defaults are stubs: calloc returns NULL and free does nothing (`platform.c:25-42`). The stubs are there so that a missing setup fails safely rather than crashing.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when the pointers aren't set up, the default stubs make calloc return NULL and free do nothing, which is a failure rather than a fallback to libc.
